text: Vale hands over his reports and even name-checks Dusk's "buried despair" as worth a look, but Flint's not letting it go, keeping the receipts front and center. Dusk doubles down on trying to pull Reed away alone to the cistern for a hands-on "listening" session — twice — but Reed refuses again, sticking to the group plan and calling in Flint as backup to watch Dusk. Everyone converges on the sluice gate as planned: Vale with surveying tools, Flint adding a Geiger counter to hunt for "anomalies," and chamomile tea firmly banned from the scene.
